summary: No relevant testing skill found. Backend-only focused verification passed: admin can suspend/reactivate Maria Rossi via PATCH; while suspended she is removed from public list/matching, direct public detail returns 404, and therapist login returns 403; after reactivation list/detail/login return to 200/normal. Also verified an existing never-verified therapist returns 404 from direct public detail. No MOCKED APIs used.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected /app/backend/server.py: public_get_terapista now returns 404 when documenti_verificati is false or sospeso is true.
Inspected /app/backend/routers/terapisti.py: sospendi endpoint persists terapista.sospeso and linked user.is_active; auth login rejects inactive users with 403 Account disattivato.
Frontend UI was not retested because the review request specified backend only / skip frontend. iteration_14 reportedly covered UI badge/toggle.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary Mongo therapist document with documenti_verificati=false to verify direct public detail hardening; it was deleted during cleanup. Maria Rossi was left with sospeso=false and linked user.is_active=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/bug_verify_terapista_sospensione_iter15.py. The script uses http://localhost:8001/api and Bearer auth fallback because Secure cookies from /auth/login are not resent by Python requests over local HTTP. Raw evidence is in /app/test_reports/bug_terapista_sospensione_iter15_api_result.json.
rca_of_the_issue: Regression target was direct public detail exposure: previous GET /api/public/terapisti/{tid} only checked existence, so suspended therapists could still be fetched directly. The fix adds detail-level documenti_verificati and sospeso gates, matching list/matching visibility rules. Verified reproduction path: activate Maria -> detail 200/list includes/login 200; suspend -> detail 404/list excludes/login 403; reactivate -> detail 200/list includes/login 200.
